questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that people may be crossing the road. Watch for pedestrians in the crosswalk. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights arranged vertically display colors from bottom to top in this order: green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: On vertical traffic signals, red is on top and green is on the bottom. On horizontal signals, red is on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign is diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. It warns that wet pavement is slippery and your vehicle may be harder to control. Drive with extra care.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a sharp right turn is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane will end soon.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves sharply to the right first, then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals are used to communicate when riding in groups. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers that when turning left on a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic. Complete the turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The railroad tracks cross the road at a steep slope. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is displaying a red light.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is displaying a green light.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic signal is at the intersection ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
Operators may turn left or continue straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Operators may turn right or continue straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you must either turn right or continue straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down when you approach it. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must let them pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road hazards. This sign tells you that low clearance is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves right and then left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This hand signal means the rider plans to slow down or stop. The left arm is bent at the elbow and pointed downward. You can use hand signals instead of or in addition to turn signals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is ahead. The road splits into two one-way sections separated by a median. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of an intersection ahead where a road joins from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This regulatory sign means you cannot turn right at this location. You must obey this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, but you may not always need to stop.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must come to a complete stop. Only move forward when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This hand signal tells the group of riders to stop. The lead rider extends their left arm straight down with the palm facing back.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells you which direction to drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: When you see an "Exit only" sign on a yellow panel, that lane leads off the highway as an exit ramp. If you stay in that lane, you must exit. You can change lanes to continue on the highway.
